Market today: The tech sector faces mixed signals. While Intel's boost to SoftBank is positive for chips, hedge fund exits could increase tech volatility, leaving retail traders with more influence. Overall, a cautious mood for tech.

Your holdings: SOXL (-51.29%) and SPAL (-64.49%) are leveraged ETFs, deeply in the red, and demand immediate attention due to decay and margin amplification. SMH (-11.21%) and QQQI (-3.4%) also need trimming. All other positions look fine today.

Watch: Closely monitor your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) for further downside. Observe how retail traders react to hedge fund exits in tech.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, underperforming positions to protect your capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider cutting losses on this leveraged ETF, currently down over 50%. Its decay and your margin amplify the pain.
SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is down over 64%. Re-evaluate its place in your portfolio given its volatility and decay.
SMH: Trim this chip ETF, currently down 11.21%, to reduce concentration and free up capital.
